query: SELECT db.id, db.bidAmount, db.status, db.paymentStatus, db.paidAt, db.dealerId, c.make, c.model, c.year, c.id as carId FROM dealerBids db JOIN cars c ON db.carId = c.id WHERE c.make LIKE '%Ford%' AND c.model LIKE '%Mustang%' AND db.status = 'won' ORDER BY db.createdAt DESC;
